title: The lane's mapping-free retrieval / counter-authority falsifier, run for the first time on the packet-of-record V3's exact bytes
why_this_instrument: The lane owns the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority falsifier (evaluation/mapping_free_recall_falsifier.py, run 39225862749, verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED), but it has only ever been run on the served packet 38839347028 and the rebuilt packet rebuilt-39027045675. The PACKET OF RECORD is 39319405429 (packet.json raw sha256 32ac812626e679c357822543d0b2e78e62c0e95a9a1b233d1ec89d7cb7b6ac70): the accepted serve verdict, the frozen LABEL/GEOMETRY falsification battery and both standing DO-NOT-SERVE orders are all pinned to those exact bytes. The lane has therefore never run its mapping-free retrieval / counter-authority falsifier on the bytes the whole product verdict rests on. This instrument closes that hole by reusing the accepted measurement functions UNCHANGED on V3's exact bytes.
hypothesis: The accepted mapping-free measurement functions (concept coverage, admission disclosure, source validity, duplicate suppression, counter-authority surface, language robustness and the frozen slug-to-question admissibility predicate), run on the packet-of-record V3's exact bytes, will falsify the product: the counter-authority surface is empty (n_issued=0) on all three served questions, so the product cannot surface contrary or limiting authority on the packet of record. A bounded negative is fully acceptable and is the expected result; it is never a pass and never a bar-met.
baseline: The same accepted measurement functions are the baseline; the instrument imports evaluation.mapping_free_recall_falsifier.measure / non_vacuity / verdict_of unchanged and reuses evaluation.retrieval_gate.gates.row_cores and evaluation.subject_match_audit. No analyst mapping is read into any gate, aggregate or verdict.
product_decision_unlocked: Whether retrieval and counter-authority discovery are good enough to justify the visual UX test. The packet-of-record's counter-authority surface is empty, so the map's audit layer cannot surface contrary authority and the comparative half of the central product question stays VACUOUS.

inputs_FROZEN.product_mount: /tmp/lex_accepted/product (read-only, accepted product branch; head recorded at run time)

packet_of_record.standing_status: BUILT_NOT_SERVED WITHHELD_PENDING_SERVE; both DO-NOT-SERVE orders stand; this instrument changes neither

inputs_FROZEN.frozen_mount_inputs: see COUNTER_AUTHORITY_SURFACE_FALSIFIER_FREEZE_RECORD.json (V3 packet.json + 3 bundles + 3 admissibility + 3 question files, all re-hashed before AND after execution)

gates_FROZEN.reused_unchanged: Every gate is the accepted mapping-free falsifier's gate, imported through its measure() function: mf::concept_coverage, mf::admission_disclosure, mf::source_validity, mf::duplicate_suppression, mf::counter_authority_surface, mf::language_robustness. The frozen slug-to-question admissibility predicate (SAME_NORM AND SAME_SUBJECT_TERMS) is also reused unchanged. This instrument introduces no new gate.
gates_FROZEN.mf::counter_authority_surface::<packet>:: PASS iff the bundle issues >=1 row whose counter status is a contrary/limiting/exception type AND every issued counter row carries a non-empty counter_evidence field. FAIL if no counter row is issued. This is the lane directive's known contrary/limiting-authority check, achieved without any mapping.

non_vacuity_controls_FROZEN.reused_unchanged: A_blanked_pool_must_fail_concept_coverage, A2_blanked_row_must_fail_source_validity, C_oracle_pool_must_pass_concept_coverage, B_admissibility_predicate_must_reject_a_subject_swapped_pair - all imported from the accepted instrument's non_vacuity() and run on V3's measured questions.

success_rule_FROZEN: PASS_NO_FALSIFICATION (exit 0) iff every mapping-free gate passes on every measured V3 bundle AND every non-vacuity control holds. PRODUCT_FALSIFIED (exit 1) if any mapping-free gate fails on V3's exact bytes, naming the packet, the question id, the gate and the measured values. NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS (exit 2) if no bundle could be read at all, or if a non-vacuity control does not hold. NOT_APPLICABLE is never a pass.
no_new_thresholds: Every numeric threshold used here is either an accepted constant imported from evaluation/subject_match_audit.py or evaluation/retrieval_gate/gates.py, or an exact structural identity (distinct ids == n, empty string is falsy, >=1 issued counter row). This instrument introduces NO new threshold, NO new bar, NO new tokeniser, NO new stoplist and NO re-tuned rule.
network_policy: zero network requests. The instrument is read-only over the accepted mount and committed records. Any live retrieval remains the accepted frozen retrieval benchmark's job and is not re-run.
what_this_does_NOT_claim: It does NOT meet, move or re-derive the frozen absolute LABEL_SOUND or GEOMETRY_SOUND bars; they stay REPORTED-ONLY.
It does NOT lift the accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order on 38839347028 nor DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED on rebuilt-39027045675, and it does NOT change V3's BUILT_NOT_SERVED / WITHHELD_PENDING_SERVE status.
It does NOT certify admission of any packet; admission stays fail-closed.
It does NOT claim the map helps a jurist; that is the human product gate's question and it remains unanswered.

It does NOT build, tune, score or re-score any candidate for any Frontier team; the accepted frontier-counter-label-emission repair is never re-run here, and where its numbers touch the accepted ones they are published BESIDE with any divergence named as the headline.
It runs no obsolete universal-174k geometry benchmark.

It does NOT re-issue the run_bar_gates frozen label/geometry falsification battery (discharged on V3 by run 39379766198); this is a different instrument measuring a different product capability (retrieval / counter-authority discovery).
success_rule_for_the_CYCLE: The cycle succeeds if it produces committed executable code, tests, a machine record and a report whose every number is recomputable from the committed tree, and exits well inside the work quantum. A falsification result is an equally acceptable, and equally accepted, outcome.
